Overview:

Gonzo Tanemaki lies in a hospital bed in a small island surrounded by his children,
who have come to say their last goodbyes.
He has lived a long, fruitful life. His hard work and dedication to rebuilding the economy of his,
once-impoverished country led to the local people's respect.
Some in the media had criticized his methods and lifestyle, but he wouldn’t have changed a thing.
And so, at the ripe old age of 98, the curtain finally closes on his life... or so he thinks.

In the blink of an eye, Gonzo awakens to see a goddess who sends him off,
to a new world where exciting new adventures await!
Who would've thought he'd end up in an elf village that would change his life forever...?!​
